title: Liebherr — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Liebherr.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Luxury tier. Liebherr is the German-Austrian refrigeration specialist — they only make one thing and they make it better than almost anyone. Their BioFresh technology keeps produce at precisely 32°F with optimal humidity, extending freshness up to three times longer than conventional refrigerators. DuoCooling uses separate cooling circuits for fridge and freezer. Every Liebherr is built in Germany or Austria.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers obsessed with food freshness. European kitchen builds. Buyers cross-shopping Sub-Zero who want a European alternative.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Liebherr:

• BioFresh keeps produce fresh up to 3x longer — backed by clinical testing

• DuoCooling — separate circuits prevent odor transfer between fridge and freezer

• German/Austrian manufacturing — not outsourced, every unit built in Europe

• SmartDevice app monitors temperature and sends alerts if anything is off

• SoftSystem doors close automatically from a 45-degree angle — no slamming
